statement: Reasonix separates batch scheduling from single-call execution, so concurrency decisions, per-call context, capability gates, tool invocation, results, and failure bookkeeping cross explicit boundaries.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix 将 batch scheduling 与 single-call execution 分离，使并发决策、per-call context、capability gate、工具调用、结果与失败记账经过明确边界。
display_text.en: Reasonix separates batch scheduling from single-call execution, so concurrency decisions, per-call context, capability gates, tool invocation, results, and failure bookkeeping cross explicit boundaries.

notes: The claim maps boundaries, not correctness under every concurrent workload.
